title: Autonomous Trust — Common Definitions
description: Shared definitions referenced by the seven Autonomous Trust contract schemas.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of the contract schema this document conforms to.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier (UUID or prefixed ULID).

riskTier.description: Risk tier of an action. R0 = read-only, R1 = low-impact reversible, R2 = production-impacting, R3 = irreversible or financially consequential.

actor.description: A human, agent, or service identity. Agents carry workload identity (e.g., SPIFFE); humans carry IdP identity (e.g., OIDC subject).

digest.description: Content digest in the form algo:hex (e.g., sha256:ab12...).

capabilityTier.description: Provider-agnostic capability class. Names a tier, never a vendor.

attestationRef.description: Reference to a signed attestation (in-toto / SLSA provenance) proving integrity and authorship of the referenced material.

principalChain.description: Ordered authority chain from the root principal (a human, or a durable service identity acting under standing human authorization) to the acting agent. Every delegated hop is present; the commit gateway refuses any action whose chain does not terminate in an authorized principal — delegation cannot launder authority.

simulationTier.description: How a proposed action's effect was determined before authorization, in descending order of trust. 'model-predicted' and 'none' are lowest-trust and must be visible to the authorizer.

obligation.description: A runtime constraint the Execution Governor must enforce as a pure enforcement point. Thresholds are policy output, never governor-local config — there is exactly one place policy is written.

type.description: e.g., max_steps, max_retries, max_tokens, max_cost_usd, max_elapsed_seconds, max_write_attempts, min_confidence_delta
